operations.before: Die lernende Person kann die Bildung von Magensäure chemisch beschreiben und daran die Wirkweise von Protonenpumpen-Hemmern erklären.
operations.after: Die lernende Person kann die Bildung von Magensäure chemisch beschreiben und daran die Wirkweise von Protonenpumpen-Hemmern erklären, indem sie einen bereitgestellten Mechanismusbeleg auswertet, im vorgegebenen idealen Stoffmengen-, Konzentrations- und pH-Modell Protonennachlieferung von Neutralisation unterscheidet und die Grenzen gegenüber klinischen Aussagen benennt.

operations.before: The learner can chemically describe gastric acid formation and use it to explain how proton pump inhibitors work.
operations.after: The learner can chemically describe gastric acid formation and use it to explain proton pump inhibitors by interpreting supplied mechanism evidence, distinguishing proton influx from neutralization in a given ideal amount, concentration and pH model, and stating the limits on clinical inference.

originalOfficialMechanismSource.actualOfficialLocator: Fachlehrplan Chemie11(NTG), C11 3.1 Arzneimittel im Verdauungssystem, first competence bullet
originalOfficialMechanismSource.officialDutyBoundary: Describe gastric acid formation and explain PPI action; this bullet does not explicitly require the supplied pH calculations or a research routine.

ownRetainedAcquisitionScope.policyBasis: Owner16October2026: retain all authored applicable target topics before a later topic selector. Existing2fac already madee1/e2/e3 and both model/source cases mandatory. This makes that own assessment extent explicit; it does not invent new source obligations.

authorTargetedScopeBoundary.singleCompetenceReason: One causal model explains formation/transport and why reducing new secretion differs from consuming existing acid. Supplied calculation/source tools make the existing model consequences inspectable. General pH approximation derivation, broad source discovery, antacid composition/side effects and treatment appraisal remain outside this goal. Numerical/source reproduction alone is not the chemical performance.
